tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Raising of 8x12 Pb seedlings at Hiremagi Nursery

itemList.description: Raising of 4x6 seedlings for transplating into 8x12 pbs
Procurement of 0.9225 cum Farm Yard Manure / Compost 0.9225 cum of Sand and 1.845 cum of Red earth. (4.20 cum required for 8x12 minus 0.51 cum of transplanted 4x6 bag
Mixing the ingredients filling the polythene bags and arranging in rows after scraping the earth
Tranplanting of 4x6 size bagged seedlings into 8x12 size bags
Watering to the polythene bagged seedlings twice a day from 01.12.2026 to 31-03-2027 (121 days)
Shifiting and grading the polythene bagged seedlings
Procurement of plant protection and growth promotion materials/ compounds, their application nursery pumpset fuel/maintenance / electricity bill of pumpset and the enforseen items and charges.
